youtube.baslik: With cholesteatoma, does good hearing mean the disease is mild? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Cholesteatoma most often erodes the long process of the incus; when the chain is broken, a marked conductive loss appears. Sometimes the cholesteatoma mass itself bridges the two broken ends and partly carries sound, so good hearing does not mean the disease is mild.

cumleler: With cholesteatoma, does good hearing mean the disease is mild?
Cholesteatoma most often erodes the long process of the incus.
When the chain breaks, a marked conductive loss appears.
Sometimes the mass itself bridges the two broken ends.
Sound is partly carried, so hearing may be better than expected.
So good hearing does not mean the disease is mild.
